en.title: Pipeline studio
en.description: Design the AI content workflow as a flow: trigger, phases, review, shortcuts.
en.seo_description: Design the AI content workflow as a flow: trigger, phases, review, shortcuts.

palette.title: Nodes
palette.hint: Drag onto the canvas or use add to append.

canvas.empty: Drag a node here or add the manual trigger to start.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.empty: Select a node to edit its name, prompt, and config.
inspector.name: Name
inspector.promptPlaceholder: What should the agent do with its input?

validation.valid: Flow is valid and ready to save.
validation.noTrigger: Add exactly one manual trigger to start the pipeline.
validation.multiTrigger: Keep exactly one trigger — remove the extra triggers.
validation.cycle: Remove the cycle so the flow runs in one direction.
validation.actionNotAtEnd: Action shortcuts must sit at the end of the chain.

toast.nameRequired: Give the new pipeline a name first

es.title: Estudio de pipelines

es.seo_description: Diseña el flujo de contenido con IA: disparador, fases, revisión y atajos.

palette.title: Nodos

canvas.empty: Arrastra un nodo aquí o añade el disparador manual para empezar.

inspector.empty: Selecciona un nodo para editar su nombre, prompt y config.
inspector.name: Nombre
inspector.promptPlaceholder: ¿Qué debe hacer el agente con su entrada?

validation.valid: El flujo es válido y está listo para guardar.
